root_cause.text: The CQE_F_MASK macro in io_uring/net.c did not include IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE, causing the flag to be dropped during cflag merging in bundle recv retries, which made userspace incorrectly advance the provided buffer ring head while the kernel still used the buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly adds `IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE` to `CQE_F_MASK`. The commit description explains: "Because IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE was not in CQE_F_MASK, the merge above silently dropped it ... Userspace would then wrongfully advance it ring head past an entry the kernel still uses." The diff shows the change from `#define CQE_F_MASK (IORING_CQE_F_SOCK_NONEMPTY|IORING_CQE_F_MORE)` to include `IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE`.
